notes.title: In-App Purchases Online Again...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621968/1cefdcc8f8df7ae2c7651c8af011afe5fb18a428.png
* In-App Purchases back in business again
* Detailed Tutorial added to the game after so many feedbacks :)
* Highscores lists top 100 now
* 2 more waves added, 72 is the top level now
* Some balance changes and fixes in allies
* Due to ally changes, Highscores will be reset. I am sure you will sympathize with that and top players will be there again :)
* When allies are all balanced, seasonal gameplay will be started soon...

Have Fun...
